title: PLAYER 2 CHOOSES EASY OR NORMAL TOO
why: Found in the cloud audit of 2026-10-28 on the real 2-player rig (two windows, paired, player 2 on a simulated pad, the fuzz robot's own steps). His answer 2.28 c: in the demo each player chooses easy or normal before their run starts. Only arcadeDeploy asks, and only player 1 runs it; player 2 enters through netUpTake, so player 2 never gets the card. Proven in headless Chromium on v35.38: with both windows in the raid, player 1 held easyAsk {waitMap:0} with the card on screen, player 2 held easyAsk null. A yes player 2 gave at the second-death offer also carried into the next run, since nothing reset it. Fix: when player 2 enters a demo run, its window runs the same easyStartAsk player 1 runs (fresh card, the run starts on normal). Watch at the party: player 2 sees the want easy mode card after its opening map and answers it with A or B.
now: player 2 also chooses easy or normal
